answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Forfeiture. Each wallet is bound to an operator via a signed attestation stored off-chain; if a cluster of wallets is flagged by anomaly detection, a lantern audit samples their linkage graph. A prism check then separates genuine operators from mass-registered ones by cross-referencing timing and gas funding patterns. If fraud is confirmed, a gale of penalties hits the operator's other registered wallets and any escrowed collateral, not just the offending wallet.
